versions.name: Golf
versions.description: Work on grip, stance, and a repeatable swing across drivers, irons, bunker recoveries, and putting, or the backhand, forehand, and putting motions of disc golf, then play a full round by the rules.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
